newsitem.title: ITALY: Specialists get 5.0 bln lire of Italy 10-yr BTPs.
newsitem.headline: Specialists get 5.0 bln lire of Italy 10-yr BTPs.

text.p: Specialist bond traders bid for and were allocated 5.0 billion lire of 10-year fixed-rate bonds (BTP) against the Italian Treasury's offer of 150 billion lire of paper.
Earlier, the Treasury received bids for 3.215 trillion lire at the open auction for the February 1, 2007 paper, against 1.5 trillion lire worth of bonds on offer.
The auction price was set at 99.10 against 97.00 and gross yield at 6.99 against 7.30 percent at the previous 10-year BTP sale on May 29.
